answer: Bind each voting seat to a public library card. The operator links the card through the library's lending API, which confirms one named patron living in the branch district and at least 12 months of loans, so a seat cannot appear overnight. Libraries issue one card per resident and check ID at the desk, so a farm of 300 seats needs 300 real residents and a year of borrowing, about $90,000 in paid stand-ins at $25 a month. A loan history of Dune, a quill calligraphy primer and a pigment chemistry text is cheap for one reader and ruinous to fake at scale.
